text:
Amit Regev the reason i ask is i had a similar issue with single status documents in the U.S. (i was already in Israel, I needed it from several counties where I didnt live very long, and where the issuing body of marriage records had never even heard of such a document let alone the visa process. The Embassies were of zero help) 

To a bureaucracy-bound worker, "no such document exists" (or in your case, no searchable ID) translates to: no form to submit = no process in place = not possible.

My breakthrough was calling/emailing the relevant records departments directly to explain: all i need is someone to look up my name in the system. Then write a letter that says "i looked up this person and no records exist for them"
